lines.text: Voices call the Shulammite to come back so they can gaze upon her, and praise her sandaled feet.
Her eyes are like the pools of Heshbon, her nose like the tower of Lebanon, her head like Mount Sinai.
The speaker says he will climb the palm tree and take hold of its fruit.
She invites her beloved to the countryside, and early to the vineyards to see if the pomegranates are in bloom.
She wishes he were like a brother so she could kiss him outdoors, then lead him to her master's house.
